payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear methodology for selecting action verbs based on frequency and syntactic patterns.

claims.text: We selected action verbs by picking 50 classes of Levin verbs and sorting them by frequency in the Google Syntax Ngrams corpus.
The selection process involved extracting core components of actions and mapping them to specific roles like agent and theme.
Our work aims to contribute to existing frame knowledge resources by investigating new approaches to recover richer frame knowledge from language.
